config.notes: TRU (Canada, no CRICOS). Page kinds: (1) tru.ca/programs/catalogue/* programme pages with a Program Details box: Credential (study level), Delivery (campus), Length (duration), Intake dates (month names, e.g. September, January, May; graduate pages follow with "Application Deadline <date>", which is excluded), International (open to international applicants). (2) Faculty/graduate pages (gaglardi, nursing): intake given as "September intake (international)", "semesters starting each September" or "Next Intake May 2026". (3) distance/Open Learning pages: no intake, fee or IELTS. Fees: catalogue pages carry only a per-semester calculator (default Canadian, about 4 courses, e.g. Tuition $1,904.40); the international figure is computed in the browser and no annual international fee is printed, so no fee pattern. IELTS is not printed on programme pages; English is a central TRU admissions rule. Terms are printed as month names so no term_months mapping is needed.
